Text messaging (SMS)

Program name. Mo Vlogs text messages, sent by VIBES FAMILY DMCC under its Mo Vlogs brand.

What the messages are for. Service messages: confirmation that we received your Build Challenge entry, updates about your entry, reminders before a deadline, and replies to something you asked us. Promotional messages, only if you ticked that box: invitations to training we are running, announcements, and information about what we offer.

VIBES FAMILY DMCC, including its Mo Vlogs brand, sends text messages only to people who ask for them. Consent is collected in two places, each with the same two separate consent boxes under the phone number field: our SMS sign-up page at https://movlogs.ai/sms, and the entry form on https://movlogs.ai/ that opens from the Enter for free button. Both boxes are optional, both start unticked, and neither is required to enter the Build Challenge or to buy anything.

How you opt in. On either page you enter your email address and your mobile number in the Phone number field, tick one or both boxes, and submit. The service box covers confirmation that we received your entry, updates about your entry, reminders before a deadline, and replies to something you asked us. The promotional box covers invitations to training we are running, announcements, and information about what we offer. We never tick a box for you, and each kind of message is sent only to numbers that ticked the box for it.

Frequency and cost. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.

Opting out and help. Reply STOP to any message to stop receiving texts. You will receive one message confirming that you have been unsubscribed, and nothing after it. Reply HELP for help.

Consent is not a condition of purchase. You can enter the Build Challenge and take part without agreeing to receive text messages.

Carriers. Mobile carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

Your number and your consent. We do not sell, rent or share your mobile number or your SMS consent with third parties or affiliates for their own marketing or promotional purposes. Mobile/SMS opt-in data and consent will not be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. SMS opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties except service providers used solely to deliver the messages.

Customer care. Reply HELP to any message, or email {SUPPORT}. {LEGAL}, {ADDRESS}.
